questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes "chemical formula" from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "kimyoviy formula" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: this is a representation of the composition of a substance using chemical symbols and, if necessary, indices
is an important quantitative characteristic of an element
the number of atoms of an element in a substance, expressed in the formula
The ability of an atom to form a certain number of chemical bonds
choicesUz: bu kimyoviy belgilar va agar kerak bo'lsa, indekslar yordamida moddaning tarkibini ifodalash
formulada ifodalangan moddadagi element atomlari soni
Atomning ma'lum miqdordagi kimyoviy bog'lanishlar hosil qilish qobiliyati
explanationEn: A chemical formula is a representation of the composition of a substance using chemical symbols and, if necessary, indices.
explanationUz: Kimyoviy formula - kimyoviy belgilar va kerak bo'lganda indekslar yordamida moddaning tarkibini ifodalash.
